title: Rate Limiting and Concurrency
snippet:
While there are no rate limits on the number of requests you can make per minute, there are concurrency limits based on your subscription plan:
- Free Account: Maximum of 1 concurrent request.
- Starter Plan: Maximum of 5 concurrent requests.
- Basic Plan: Maximum of 10 concurrent requests.
- Pro Plan: Maximum of 20 concurrent requests.
- Business Plan: Maximum of 40 concurrent requests.
To check your current concurrency limits:
- Log in to your HarvestAPI account.
- Navigate to your [Subscription Page](https://harvestapi.io/admin/subscription).
- Review your plan details to see your concurrency limits.
Exceeding your concurrency limits should put your next requests in a queue. The queue size is 10 per account.
Exceeding the queue size will result in an error response.
Ensure that your application manages concurrent requests appropriately to stay within your plan’s limits.

This means, for example on Basic plan:
- 60 / 1.3 * 10 ~ 461 companies per minute processed on average when using maximum concurrency.
- 60 / 4.9 * 10 ~ 122 full profiles per minute processed on average when using maximum concurrency.

title: The Harvest API
snippet:
# The Harvest API
Your Harvest subscription includes API access for all accounts (including free and trial accounts) which can be used to manage your Harvest account. Our [API documentation](https://help.getharvest.com/api-v2) provides all of the details necessary to get started.
## Common API questions
### How do I get access to the API?
All Harvest accounts are able to access the Harvest API. API permissions will mirror [account permissions](https://support.getharvest.com/hc/en-us/articles/360048687451); Administrators can access all API calls, Managers can access the projects and people they manage, and Members can only access their own data. Harvest will check your permissions on each request and actions that are not available to you in the UI will return HTTP 401 on the API.

### Does Harvest throttle API requests?
Yes — details on throttling (including limits) can be found in [our API overview documentation](https://help.getharvest.com/api-v2/introduction/overview/general/#rate-limiting).
